snippet.title: Professor Cubs
snippet.description:
Howdy, this channel is dedicated to helping professionals, job seekers and students learn software apps and business skills.  

ABOUT THE PROF:
Dave, affectionately dubbed “Professor Cubs” by his students, has been a corporate trainer teaching both popular apps and business skills for the past 20+ years.  

Some of the courses he’s taught include MS Office (Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint, VISIO, Outlook), along with other like Tableau, PowerBI, PowerQuery, Salesforce, SharePoint, and the list goes on...  

Later in his career he moved into teaching business skills (interviewing, resume writing, etc.), digital marketing (eCommerce, Web Design, social media, etc.)  along with all the latest happenings in the world of AI tutorials. 

Best known for his casual, yet dry-witted, permanently quipping comedic teaching style, he's taught for major corporations, as well as over 150,000+ students, worldwide.  

Inquiries: heyprofessorcubs @ gmail.com

If you'd like to sponsor a Huge If True episode, reach out at the email below.

If you're looking for my bio, here it is:
Cleo Abram is a video journalist who produces Huge If True, an optimistic show about science and technology. Huge If True is an antidote to the doom and gloom, helping a wide audience see better futures they can help build. In each episode, Cleo dives deep into one innovation that could shape the future. She has explored humanoid robots at Boston Dynamics, supersonic planes at NASA, quantum computers at IBM, the Large Hadron Collider at CERN, and more. Previously, Cleo was a video producer at Vox and directed for Explained on Netflix. She was the host of Vox’s first ever daily show, Answered, as well as co-host of Vox’s YouTube Originals show, Glad You Asked.
